text:
Asha: three-emoji mood challenge + 5-sec jingle. post 3 emojis that sum up your week and a one-liner jingle (sing it in your head). go! :star-struck:
Ben: 😂🏃‍♂️☕ — 'Coffee ran, still on time.'
Carmen: 🐢📚🌧 — 'Slow pages, fast umbrellas.'
Derek: 🚀🤯🎉 — 'Ship it, then celebrate.'
Frank: 😬🍝🛠 — 'Debugging over pasta, applause optional.'
KudosBot: :tada: Shoutout to Carmen for organizing the book swap! (5 kudos)
Asha: tiny poll: after-jingle snack? chocolate / fruit / chips. react with :chocolate_bar: / :banana: / :potato:
Ben: :chocolate_bar: obviously.
Carmen: :banana: Im trying to be an influencer of my own snacks.
Derek: :potato: for science.
OpsBot: Reminder: keep communal music and loud sing-alongs below moderate volume before 4pm. Thanks!
Asha: love these. bonus one-liner round: drop the shortest jingle you can. Derek wins with 'Ship, sip, smile.'
Frank: my entry: 'Oops, fixed it.' (one second)
Asha: wrap: new mini tradition? maybe weekly micro-challenges. thumbs up if yes. :thumbsup:
All: :thumbsup:
